observations: Photo 0 shows a large blue plastic barrel with a black lid and a black D-ring handle. The barrel has visible scratches and wear. Other similar blue barrels are in the background.

Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same blue barrel, focusing on a white label attached to the side. The label is partially legible but contains technical details including 'BP-1000', '25000kg', and 'MADE IN NOA'.
The label appears to be a product specification sticker, not a manufacturer label. The text is not fully readable due to angle and lighting.
The barrel is outdoors on a concrete surface, suggesting storage or outdoor use.
The seller claims '80 liters' capacity, but the label in photo 1 does not confirm this; it shows 'BP-1000' and '25000kg', which is inconsistent with 80L capacity.
